subject: Marketplace preflight: DataPulse listing & co-sell language
messages:
From: Riya Patel <riya.patel@aws-partners.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@datapulse.com>, AWS Marketplace Review <aws-marketplace-review@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing preflight: DataPulse Analytics

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the time to review DataPulse's proposed listing. They've been approved for co-sell, but marketplace ops flagged several items that need alignment before approval: branding copy that references "unlimited inference", a support SLA section that doesn't match AWS Marketplace's published minimums, and a missing IP attribution line for joint co-sell materials.

I've attached the marketplace checklist and the initial draft listing from DataPulse (marketplace_listing_draft_v2.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the following or propose alternative language: 

- Replace "unlimited inference" claim with quantifiable limits or "scale according to plan" language.
- Support SLA must include a 24x7 critical escalation path and a 99.9% uptime commitment for Dedicated customers.
- Branding assets need a single logo lockup (vector) and the vendor partner badge to be displayed per spec.

DataPulse is targeting an end-of-July listing publish. Would you and your legal/product folks be able to review the attached and confirm feasibility?

Best,
Riya Patel
Partner Programs Manager, AWS Partners

Attachments: marketplace_checklist_aws.xlsx (spreadsheet), marketplace_listing_draft_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Riya Patel <riya.patel@aws-partners.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@datapulse.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing preflight: DataPulse Analytics

Riya — thanks for the clear list and the draft. Looping in Avery (product) and Laura (legal) to confirm. Quick take from my side:

- Branding/claims: We should avoid absolutes like "unlimited". Proposed replacement wording: "scale to meet your throughput requirements (subject to plan limits)" — happy to provide a 1-2 line alternative.
- SLA: Redwood can commit to a co-sell-facing minimum for Hosted API only today; Dedicated SLA needs contract-level commitment. The 99.9% is plausible for Dedicated under a reserved capacity agreement but requires a deal addendum and premium support.
- IP/attribution: We typically accept the partner badge and a short attribution line; will confirm exact phrasing.

Attachments I'm adding: support_sla_table.xlsx (internal recommended SLA tiers), brand_assets.zip (vector logo + lockup guidelines).

Next steps: Avery and Laura, could you review the attached and confirm (a) whether the suggested claim language is acceptable, (b) what redlines we need for the listing PDF, and (c) estimated timeline to produce a final redline by EOD tomorrow? Samir — if you can confirm any non-negotiable marketplace copy from DataPulse's side, that helps.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: support_sla_table.xlsx, brand_assets.zip

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Riya Patel <riya.patel@aws-partners.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@datapulse.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing preflight: DataPulse Analytics

Thanks Mina — quick product notes after a 30-min sync with infra and support: 

- Claims: We will replace "unlimited inference" with: "Scales to customer workload with plan-based throughput guarantees" — this maps to our Reserved/Dedicated capacity docs. I'll paste final snippet into the listing PDF and push back to Samir for sign-off.
- SLA tiers: See attached support_sla_table.xlsx — two options: Standard (business hours) vs Premium (24x7 critical). For co-sell, AWS requires the Premium baseline; that implies a surcharge for Dedicated commitments.
- Co-sell badge: Brand team requires vendor badge usage guidelines; Mina, the brand_assets.zip contains the correct lockup.

Laura — can Legal provide redlines for the marketplace copy and a short addendum template we can attach to Dedicated contracts? If legal can return a redline by EOD today, we can make the publish window.

Avery Johnson
Senior Product Manager, GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: support_sla_table.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Riya Patel <riya.patel@aws-partners.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@datapulse.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing preflight: DataPulse Analytics

Avery / Mina — attached is a redline of the listing (listing_redline_v1.pdf) and a short addendum template for Dedicated SLA commitments. Summary of legal redlines: 

1) Claims language: remove any "unlimited" phrasing and add a clarifying parenthetical tying throughput claims to the "applicable plan or reserved capacity agreement."
2) SLA: Acceptable to offer 99.9% for Dedicated where the customer signs the Dedicated Addendum. For Hosted listings, we will include a "service-level intent" language rather than a contractual SLA.
3) Intellectual property: Add a 1-sentence attribution line: "Redwood Inference and DataPulse retain their respective intellectual property; use of logos and marks is governed by the partner brand guidelines."

I'm comfortable with the proposed product language Avery suggested, pending Samir's confirmation on customer copy. If Samir can return sign-off on the new claim phrase and logo usage by EOD, we can push the redlined PDF to AWS Marketplace ops and request scheduling for co-sell enablement.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference Legal Team

Attachments: listing_redline_v1.pdf, dedicated_sla_addendum_template.docx
